neighbours.label: A linker after a comma that adds a further case to what came before: 'let alone', 'much less', 'to say nothing of', 'one of which', 'three of whom'
fire: He can barely read a menu, let alone write a novel.
She never visited the city, much less lived there.
The firm lost its clients, to say nothing of its reputation.
The roof leaks badly, not to mention the broken boiler.
She wrote nine novels, one of which became a film.
They have four daughters, three of whom live abroad.
He bought six paintings, none of which were genuine.
The club has ten members, most of whom are retired.
quiet: He can barely read a menu or write a novel.
She never visited the city or lived there.
The firm lost its clients and also its reputation.
The roof leaks badly, and the boiler is broken.
She wrote nine novels, and one became a film.
They have four daughters, and three live abroad.
He bought six paintings, but they were not genuine.
The club has ten members, and most are retired.

predictions: These linkers fire; plain coordination of the same content stays quiet.
short: add-on link: let alone, one of which
